test_moshi_tokenizer_full: test the Moshi tokenizer by tokenizing text and converting tokens to IDs using PreTrainedTokenizerFast
test_moshi_converter_sentencepiece: test the MoshiConverter to convert a SentencePiece vocab model into a HuggingFace tokenizer object
test_moshi_train_new_tokenizer: test training a new Moshi tokenizer from a text corpus using train_new_from_iterator
test_moshi_special_tokens: test adding special tokens to the Moshi tokenizer using AddedToken and additional_special_tokens
test_moshi_encode_decode: test encoding text to IDs and decoding IDs back to text with the Moshi fast tokenizer
